report_type_stated: Seven days before the November Election
notes: Older pre-2013 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT' form (county-office-only variant; 4 report-type boxes, no school-board line). Only the CUMULATIVE column is filled. Ending balance LEFT BLANK: the handwritten figure reads as either 4,287.87 or 4,957.87 and could not be resolved at 900dpi (bilevel scan) - not guessed. For reference the form's own arithmetic (24,622.52+170.00-19,834.65) would give 4,957.87. Form signed 10-29-12; index.csv carries filing date 2012-10-30 (clerk receipt).  CORRECTED 2026-08-14 (tranche 3 Phase B, weber itemization wave). The 2026-08-01 totals tranche read the cover's line-1 cumulative as 24,622.52 and left the ending balance BLANK ('reads as either 4,287.87 or 4,957.87, did not resolve at 900 dpi'). Both are settled by the DOCUMENT'S OWN ARITHMETIC, not by any glyph re-read, and all three identities agree on 24,122.52 / 4,287.87 while none closes under 24,622.52: (a) Schedule A page 2's printed SUBTOTAL 1,950.00 + page 3's printed total 22,172.52 = 24,122.52, which is exactly what page 2's own 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (Sum of Subtotals from All Schedule A Pages)' line prints; (b) the filer's Summary Page (p6, Column A line 1) states 24,292.52 = 24,122.52 + the 170.00 sub-$50 aggregate on cover line 2; (c) the cover's own line-4 balance 4,287.87 = 24,122.52 - 19,834.65 (line 3) exactly. The misread is explained by this filer's hand, which writes the digit 2 as a 'd' -- '24,1dd' is 24,122. Schedule B is untouched and already exact (17,846.84 + 1,987.81 = 19,834.65). Evidence: pp. 1-6 of the filing; 700 dpi tight crops of the page-2 amount column, the page-2 subtotal/total lines and the cover summary cells were used for LEGIBILITY only.

contributions.detail: 38 Schedule A rows sum to 24,172.52 against the printed 24,122.52: page 2's printed SUBTOTAL (1,950.00) is $50 short of its own six rows (1,000 + 100 + 250 + 100 + 300 + 250 = 2,000.00, each re-read at a 700 dpi tight crop), and that $50 propagates into the grand total and the cover. Page 3 closes EXACTLY (22,172.52). FILER arithmetic, verbatim, never adjusted.

itemized.notes: THE ONE FILING IN THIS CORPUS ON THE OLD STATE FORM FAMILY (Schedule A / Schedule B / Summary Page), entirely handwritten, and the wave's ARITHMETIC-REVERSAL case. **The stated cumulative contribution total published by the 2026-08-01 tranche (24,622.52) is WRONG; the figure is 24,122.52**, and the ending balance published as BLANK ('4,287.87 or 4,957.87, unresolved at 900 dpi') is **4,287.87**. Three independent identities in the document decide it, none of them a glyph re-read: (a) page-2 subtotal 1,950.00 + page-3 total 22,172.52 = 24,122.52, which is what page 2's own 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (Sum of Subtotals from All Schedule A Pages)' line prints; (b) the filer's Summary Page (p6) states total contributions 24,292.52 = 24,122.52 + the 170.00 sub-$50 aggregate; (c) the cover's balance 4,287.87 = 24,122.52 - 19,834.65 exactly. Under 24,622.52 none of the three closes. The filer's own hand writes '2' as a 'd', which is what made '24,1dd' read as 24,6.. at 200 dpi. Donor street addresses printed on the schedule are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY.md: the structured layer stores donor city/state only).
